conjectures.name: Plastic-A extremality
conjectures.statement: Plastic-A has maximal normalized coincidence horizon among root three-letter primitive irreducible Pisot specimens in the declared survey domain.

conjectures.name: Iterate-family exhaustion above depth four
conjectures.statement: Every three-letter coincidence depth greater than four arises, up to relabeling, from the Plastic-A iterate family.
conjectures.primary_test: quotient deep specimens by relabeling and iteration

conjectures.name: Threshold-horizon alignment
conjectures.statement: For canonical deep chains, n0 = H + s0 for a seed-scale offset s0.
conjectures.primary_test: compare exact threshold and horizon after seed normalization

conjectures.name: FM quotient universality
conjectures.statement: The canonical first radius-zero witness compression is the off-diagonal/FM quotient, and every nontrivial consecutive noncoincident transport is detected modulo some prime.
conjectures.primary_test: FM quotient atlas with exact replayable witnesses

conjectures.name: Small-prime detection
conjectures.statement: A small finite set of primes detects all radius-zero FM transport in the three-letter benchmark domain; p=2 is a stronger candidate on deep chains.

conjectures.name: Padovan extremal skeleton
conjectures.statement: Plastic-A is the unique three-letter extremal benchmark whose witness activation timing is governed by the Padovan recurrence, up to relabeling and iteration.
conjectures.primary_test: recurrence-family classification of root extremal specimens

conjectures.name: Terminal x^d=x+1 Pisot branch
conjectures.statement: The x^d=x+1 Pisot branch relevant to these benchmarks terminates at the Fibonacci/plastic cases; higher-alphabet continuations of the same extremal mechanism require a different family.
conjectures.primary_test: targeted literature stop/go plus exact root analysis

conjectures.name: Three-letter extremal difficulty
conjectures.statement: The three-letter plastic case maximizes normalized coincidence horizon among tested root families.

negative_controls.name: Exotic-B
negative_controls.purpose: active quotient may fail while FM quotient still detects transport
negative_controls.guards_against: promoting specimen-dependent active/inert compression to a universal theorem

promotion_gate: Mojo canonical implementation for executable diagnostics
no claim beyond exact finite or proved domain
